description: This Swift source file defines a protocol and a class for macOS Node Runtime Main Actor Services, including screen recording and location services functionalities.

classes.name: LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices
classes.description: Implementation of MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices that provides screen recording and location services.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Records the screen with specified parameters and returns the path to the recorded file along with audio presence info.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status for location services.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the current accuracy authorization for location services.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current location with specified accuracy, max age, and timeout.
